tagline: OV-103 — third Shuttle. Deployed Hubble (STS-31, 1990); flew both return-to-flight missions. 39 missions — most of any orbiter
description: Third operational orbiter; first flight STS-41-D (1984-08-30). The most-flown Shuttle — 39 missions over 27 years. Career highlights: STS-31 (1990-04-24) deployed the Hubble Space Telescope; STS-26 (1988-09-29) was the post-Challenger return-to-flight; STS-114 (2005-07-26) was the post-Columbia return-to-flight; STS-95 (1998) returned John Glenn to orbit at age 77; multiple ISS-assembly flights (STS-92, 120, 124, 128, 131, 133). Final flight STS-133 (2011-02-24) delivered the Leonardo Permanent Multipurpose Module. On display at Udvar-Hazy since 2012.
best_known_for: Most-flown Shuttle (39 missions); deployed Hubble + flew both return-to-flight missions
